{
  "dataset_name": "taiwanese_bankruptcy_prediction",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "profitability_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted average of normalized ROA measures capturing overall profitability strength.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "profitability",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth linear projection of multiple correlated ROA signals, ideal for SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(ROA_C_Before_Interest_Depreciation + ROA_A_Before_Interest_After_Tax + ROA_B_Before_Interest_Depreciation_After_Tax) / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "leverage_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Continuous severity score for balance-sheet leverage; higher means more debt relative to equity/assets.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "leverage",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a clean linear leverage axis useful for separating distressed firms.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Debt_Ratio_Percent + (1.0 - Net_Worth_to_Assets) + Current_Liability_to_Assets"
    },
    {
      "name": "liquidity_strength",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite liquidity indicator combining working capital and quick/current asset ratios.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "liquidity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth bounded liquidity axis for linear margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Working_Capital_to_Total_Assets + Quick_Assets_to_Total_Assets + Current_Assets_to_Total_Assets"
    },
    {
      "name": "cash_flow_coverage",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average of cash flow coverage ratios over assets, liability, and equity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cash_flow",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous measure of operational cash sufficiency aligned with linear separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Cash_Flow_to_Total_Assets + Cash_Flow_to_Liability + CFO_to_Assets) / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "earnings_margin_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average of gross margin and net income ratio capturing earnings quality.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "profitability",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Margin-based smooth signal helpful for linear weight assignment.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Operating_Gross_Margin + Net_Income_to_Total_Assets + Gross_Profit_to_Sales) / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_operating_expense_rate",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled operating expense rate to tame heavy-tailed magnitudes for linear models.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 25.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses extreme values so SVM weights remain stable.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(Operating_Expense_Rate)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_total_asset_growth",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled total asset growth rate addressing heavy tail distribution.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 25.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides linearized growth axis for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(Total_Asset_Growth_Rate)"
    },
    {
      "name": "interest_burden_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between pre-tax and after-tax interest rates plus interest expense ratio capturing finance cost pressure.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "interest_cost",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights interest cost burden as continuous severity feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Interest_Expense_Ratio + np.abs(PreTax_Net_Interest_Rate - AfterTax_Net_Interest_Rate)"
    },
    {
      "name": "retained_earnings_deficit",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Shortfall of retained earnings to assets from unity, a key distress severity indicator (Altman-like).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "distress_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct linear distress proxy with monotonic relationship to bankruptcy risk.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(1.0 - Retained_Earnings_to_Total_Assets, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "altman_like_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Approximate linear composite inspired by Altman Z-score weighting key solvency dimensions.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "distress_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Hand-crafted linear projection capturing financial distress, aligning with SVM hyperplane.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.2 * Working_Capital_to_Total_Assets + 1.4 * Retained_Earnings_Total_Assets_proxy * 0 + 1.4 * Retained_Earnings_to_Total_Assets + 3.3 * ROA_A_Before_Interest_After_Tax + 0.6 * Net_Worth_to_Assets - 1.0 * Debt_Ratio_Percent"
    },
    {
      "name": "operational_efficiency_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall operational efficiency considering turnover, margins and per-person productivity. Higher means more efficient.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "operational_quality",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-formulaic synthesis of efficiency signals useful as additional linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_fragility_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of financial fragility integrating leverage, liquidity, cash flow adequacy, and earnings quality. Higher means more fragile.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "distress_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Holistic continuous fragility score complementing formula features for SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
